items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: One of my cousins, one of my aunt's sons, he was a very good dancer, Jess Jackson... I used to try to imitate some of his steps.

ctx.x: Alone, yeah, alone. And I'd be home-working and tried to figure out the dance notations and get myself a few steps going. One of my cousins, one of my aunt's sons, he was a very good dancer, Jess Jackson, he was a tap dancer. He was self-taught but he used to dance and I used to try to imitate some of his steps.
